title: Lisan ud-Dawat Exam Paper Generator
description: A tool that helps teachers build Lisan ud-Dawat exam papers in minutes. It supports MCQs, fill-in-the-blanks, short and long answers and translation sections, with full right-to-left layout and Dawat fonts. It generates the cover page, numbers the sections, totals the marks and exports a print-ready PDF, and it can shuffle questions to make different sets from a reusable question bank.
